default_blocked_params_descr.message: These are the default parameters that Neat URL will remove from the URL.

blocked_params_descr.message:
Case-sensitive parameters that will be removed from the URL. Use param@domain.com to use domain-specific blocked parameters.

Parameter rules

icon_animation_descr.message: Animation to use when Neat URL is cleaning up the URL.

icon_theme_descr.message: By default the icons follow the theme of the browser: light icons on a dark theme, dark icons on a light theme. You can also always use dark or light icons.

show_counter_descr.message: Show a counter which displays the number of rewritten URLs.

counter_background_color_descr.message: The background color used by the counter.

websites_descr.message: Where Neat URL cleans URLs. A domain also covers its subdomains, wildcards work too: archive.* for archive.org and archive.ph. Both choices keep their own list.

websites_only_empty.message: When this list is empty, Neat URL cleans URLs on all websites.

change_links_in_page_descr.message: Remove blocked parameters from all links when loading a page

host_permission_missing.message: Neat URL needs access to all websites to clean URLs.

linkumori_notice.message: Linkumori is Neat URL again. Your own parameters and whitelisted domains are kept: you find them in Blocked parameters and under Websites (All websites, except these domains).

clean_nested_descr.message: Also clean a URL that is the value of a parameter, for example ?url=https://example.com/?utm_source=x. This is off by default, because some websites check that such a link was not changed.

keep_signed_urls_descr.message: Don't change URLs with a signature parameter (sig, hmac or a name that ends with signature). Changing them breaks downloads and links.

remove_text_fragments_descr.message: Remove the text that a link highlights on the page (#:~:text=...), which search engines and "Copy link to highlight" add. The page then no longer scrolls to that text. An anchor like #section stays.

import_export_descr.message: Save all preferences to a file, or load them from a file.

import_failed.message: This file doesn't contain Neat URL preferences.

log_descr.message: The last URLs that Neat URL cleaned. The log is only kept in memory and is empty after a browser restart.

log_save.message: Save log for a bug report
log_save.description: Saves the log to a file

log_report_descr.message: Is a URL cleaned wrongly, or does a website no longer work? Save the log and attach the file to a new issue on GitHub. The file contains the URLs below and your preferences, so use the filter to save only the URLs that matter.

log_clear_confirm.message: Are you sure you want to clear the log? The $COUNT$ cleaned URLs in it will be removed.

log_empty.message: No URLs have been cleaned yet.

log_empty_since.message: No URLs have been cleaned since $SINCE$.
log_empty_since.description: Shown on the Log tab when the log is empty. $SINCE$ is the time of the browser start or of the last Clear.

log_column_rules.description: Column with the parameter rules that cleaned the URL

log_save_always.message: Always included: the version of Neat URL, your browser and platform, and your other preferences.

log_save_urls.message: The cleaned URLs that are shown ($COUNT$)

log_save_own_rules_descr.message: Uncheck what you'd rather keep private. In the file, rules that are left out are replaced by "(own rule)".

language_browser.description: First choice of the language picker: use the language of the browser

menu_enabled.description: Checkbox in the menu of the toolbar button: Neat URL is enabled

about.description: Shown on the options page. $ENGINE$ is the name of a browser API and is not translated.

test_url_descr.message: Paste a URL to see what Neat URL removes. The test uses the preferences on this page, also when they are not saved yet.

test_url_placeholder.description: An example URL, shown in the empty field

test_url_unchanged.message: Neat URL doesn't change this URL.

test_url_not_web.message: Neat URL doesn't change this URL: only http:// and https:// URLs are cleaned.

test_url_blacklisted.message: Neat URL doesn't change this URL: the domain is in the list "All websites, except these domains" under Websites.

test_url_not_whitelisted.message: Neat URL doesn't change this URL: the domain is not in the list "Only these domains" under Websites.

test_url_signed.message: Neat URL doesn't change this URL: it is a signed URL ("Keep signed URLs" on the Advanced tab).

test_url_suggestions.message: Which parameter do you want to remove? Click a rule to add it to the blocked parameters, then save.

test_url_rule_value.description: A rule that removes the parameter only when it has this value

test_url_invalid.message: This is not a valid URL.

default_blocked_params_uncheck.message: Uncheck a parameter or a category to keep it in URLs.

default_params_count.description: Shown above the list of default blocked parameters

use_default_params_descr.message: Turn this off to remove only your own blocked parameters. Parameters that a new version of Neat URL adds are then off too. Your choices in the list below are kept.

default_params_off.message: Off: only your own blocked parameters are removed

use_default_params_confirm.message: You have no blocked parameters of your own, so Neat URL won't remove any parameter. Turn off the default blocked parameters anyway?

no_params_warning.message: Neat URL removes no parameters: turn on the default blocked parameters or add your own blocked parameters.

list_hint.message: Separate items with a comma or a new line.

list_looks_like_domain.message: Looks like a domain, not a parameter: $ITEMS$. For a parameter on one domain, write parameter@domain.

url_request_types_choose_descr.message: Neat URL cleans the URLs of these kinds of requests. The default is main_frame: the page that is opened in a tab. See the list of resource types.
url_request_types_choose_descr.description: Please leave the link intact. You can translate the normal text and the text of the link. main_frame must stay the same.

request_types_none.message: No type is chosen, so main_frame is used.

restore_defaults_descr.message: Put all preferences back to their default values. Nothing changes until you save.

import_confirm.message: Import $COUNT$ preferences from $FILE$? They replace your current preferences.
import_confirm.description: $FILE$ is the name of the file

sync_descr.message: Use the same preferences on every device where this option is on. They are stored with your browser account (Firefox Sync, or your Google or Microsoft account).

sync_downloaded.message: Preferences of another device received on $TIME$.

sync_too_big.message: Not synchronized: the preferences are larger than the 100 KB that the browser allows. Use Export and Import instead.

sync_newer_version.message: Not synchronized: another device uses a newer version of Neat URL. Update Neat URL on this device.

sync_failed.message: Synchronizing failed. Is sync turned on in the browser?

sync_confirm.message:
Another device has already synchronized its preferences, and they are different from the preferences here.

OK: use the preferences of the other device.
Cancel: keep the preferences of this device and send them to the other devices.
